## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 and claim-4 are unsupported; no citable excerpt establishes the asserted unavailability.
- The central deliverable was not retrieved: no bounded full-text excerpt contains equations (8)–(10), complete Definition 2.1, Lemma 2.5, and Theorems 4.4–4.5.
- claim-2 and claim-3 identify adjacent metadata and the 2011 paper but do not satisfy the source-29 extraction requirement.
- The draft correctly states that the requested target is **not established** and does not substitute a broader result.
- Alternate-provider searches were executed, but they yielded no theorem-level full text; consequently theorem hypotheses remain undistinguished from proof-only restrictions.

## Unresolved certificates
- [source-refresh] Retrieve one uncorrupted, bounded, citable full-text excerpt corresponding to source-29, from an alternate literature provider, with stable locators covering equations (8)–(10), complete Definition 2.1 valid-tuple inequalities, Lemma 2.5, and Theorems 4.4–4.5; use the excerpt to classify theorem hypotheses versus proof-only restrictions.
